title: •Alderaan (Blown Away)
caption: ◊◊◊ Asteroid Field (Light) (V)
game_text: May not be deployed if an Alderaan site (or sector) on table. Star Cruisers ignore location deployment restrictions in their game text.
dark_text: When deployed, you choose: flip Set Your Course For Alderaan immediately or at the end of your next turn.

notes: Full portrait SYSTEM overlay. The slip renames the card: both bars read '•ALDERAAN (BLOWN AWAY)' (red • on the Light bar, white • on the upside-down Dark bar); caption '◊◊◊ Asteroid Field (Light) (V)' (three ◊ with a space before 'Asteroid'). Base = Asteroid Field (Light), a Dagobah ◊◊◊ SECTOR (no parsec); the slip turns it into a system with parsec box '2' on both bars. Each bar has one icon box = black with white stars → 'space' (the printed card's icon is Space). Light bar: blue saber glow in the Force slot → light_force true. Dark bar (top, upside down): the Force slot is empty black → dark_force false (the printed card has a Dark Force icon there). No scomp. RIGHT MARGIN: above the VS13 set sphere sits a second sphere — orange with a white starburst in a silver ring — which matches the Special Edition set icon (assets/icons/set-se-grainy.png); not a Dagobah icon. Not in the site-note's icon list, so icons [] here; the renderer will need to decide whether to print it (possibly marks the 'Alderaan (Blown Away)' as SE-related). Stub text matches the slip. Sites/systems have no lore. Only a 350 px scan (Dagobah-L-asteroidfield.gif); copyright not legible, Dagobah 1997 by set. No modern remake found.
